title: Revit governed levels, grids, scope boxes, and reference elements
test_intent: Determine whether applicable Revit levels, grids, scope boxes, and reference planes resolve to governed project datum/reference sources, naming and purpose rules, and controlled graphics without unexplained duplicates, offsets, temporary residue, or local drift.

applicability.applies_when: The tested Revit model contains levels, grids, scope boxes, reference planes, or equivalent governed datum/reference objects.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No governed datum/reference object is present in the tested scope.

required_evidence: applicable project datum, level, grid, survey/control, or coordination source
inventory of levels, grids, scope boxes, and reference planes in the tested scope
applicable governed naming or project configuration for persistent datum/reference objects
cross-model comparison evidence where shared datum/grid alignment is required
applicable graphics/view-template state for datum representation
approved exception or temporary-object records where applicable

result_logic.pass: Applicable datum/reference objects match the available authoritative project source and governed naming/purpose rules; required cross-model alignment is maintained; persistent objects have justified purpose; temporary objects are resolved for the applicable issue state; and datum graphics use governed controls or approved exceptions.
result_logic.fail: A positive violation is found, including a level or grid that conflicts with an available authoritative source, unexplained duplicate or near-duplicate datum, unapproved local offset or competing grid system, persistent unnamed/unjustified reference object, unresolved temporary datum at an applicable issue gate, or unexplained graphics override against an available governed rule.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed datum/reference object is within the tested scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The authoritative project datum/grid source, applicable naming configuration, expected scope-box/reference purpose, or other evidence required to determine conformance is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E ATS for Revit datum/reference conformance. Source example level names, grid schemes, scope-box names, reference-plane names, spacing values, and graphics remain noncanonical; missing project configuration produces an indeterminate result rather than invented authority.
